**This repository does not take pull requests.** The code lives in two repositories, so please open your pull request there:

- [frodo-cli](https://github.com/rockcarver/frodo-cli/compare) (command line interface)
- [frodo-lib](https://github.com/rockcarver/frodo-lib/compare) (library)

Report a suspected vulnerability privately, as described in each repository's security policy. Do not open a pull request for it.
